_doc: Hand-written layer on top of the extracted graph: links static analysis can't see (dependency-injected callbacks, rows relayed from a table to a topic, a Redis list read by another process), named end-to-end flows, the failure catalogue and per-service notes. Refs are node ids, or 'file-or-Class#name' shorthand resolved by build.mjs (it prints any ref it can't find).

edges.l: RPUSH mail_queue (LEGACY mode, or outbox not published in time)
BLPOP mail_queue (55 s block) in the worker loop
ZADD retry (5 s doubling, max 30 s)
row in outbox_events, relayed by streams
best-effort wake-up via the Redpanda HTTP proxy
hls.js loads master.m3u8 and chunks (cached in IndexedDB)
fetches every chunk, measures TTFB / total
presigned PUT (30 min) for raw uploads

examples.InteractionApiController#trackBatch: HTTP 202 Accepted — events are deduped by eventId, so resending a batch is safe
examples.TelemetryProducer#sendPlay:
PlayEvent (Avro) on listening.play.v1, key = userId:
{ meta:{event_id:"0192…", occurred_at:…}, user_id, song_id, listened_ratio:0.82, duration_ms:214000, ranges:[{start_ms:0,end_ms:176000}], seeks:[], quality:"320kbps", platform:"ios", startup_ms:310, rebuffer_count:0 }
examples.AnalyticsSink#timeline: UPSERT song_timeline (song_id, sec, listens, exits, skips, seeks_away, seeks_into) — absolute totals, one batched statement per poll
examples.WebhookJobFinalizeView.post: 200 { status: "completed", songId } — idempotent: a COMPLETED job returns the same answer
examples.SongListView.post: 201 { jobId, songId, status: "QUEUED" } — the song row appears only after /finalize

flows.title: Play a song (mobile app)
flows.summary: Tap a song → queue + radio → expo-audio streams HLS from S3. Similar songs fill the queue.

steps.text: User taps a song on Home
Redux thunk sets the queue and starts a radio session
Reports the previous partial listen, hydrates the song (GET /api/songs/{id} if songKey is missing)
Resolves {S3}/{songKey}/master.m3u8 and replaces the active expo-audio player
HLS master + 128/240/320 kbps fMP4 chunks served from S3
Fetches similar songs and appends them to the queue
Preloads the next tracks into standby players

flows.title: Play a song (web player)
flows.summary: SongCard → playWithRadio → hls.js with an IndexedDB chunk cache.

steps.text: User clicks a song card
Sets the queue and radio seed
Auth gate (opens the sign-in modal), hydrates the song, updates the store
Loads hls.js, attaches the <audio>, plays
Chunks come from S3, cached in IndexedDB by CachedFragmentLoader

flows.title: Listen telemetry → Kafka → analytics
flows.summary: The app batches listens; core publishes Avro to Kafka; Kafka Streams aggregates into small tables; the raw events land in the S3 lake.

steps.text: Track ends (or changes): the ListenTracker returns played ranges, seeks, quality, startup, stalls
Builds the play event
Stored in AsyncStorage with a UUIDv7 id (max 500)
Every 10 s / on app background: POST /api/interaction/batch (50 per request)
Rate-limited per user, then handed to the producer (EVENTS_MODE decides Kafka vs legacy)
Avro PlayEvent to listening.play.v1
Kafka topic, 7-day retention
Dedupe by event_id; per-second heatmap, daily totals, delivery quality
Batched upserts into song_timeline / song_listen_daily / song_quality_daily
Same topic also writes user_history and song stream counts
lake-writer copies the raw events to S3 as Parquet every 15 min

flows.title: Sign in with an email code (OTP)
flows.summary: Login sends a one-time code by email; verifying it creates a session and JWT pair; refresh rotates tokens.

steps.text: App posts the email to /auth/login
Rate limit per IP (Redis), then the service
Creates the OTP (Redis otp:…) and queues the email
Outbox row for notification.email.v1 (Redis list fallback)
streams sends the email through SES / Resend / SMTP; retries, then DLQ
User enters the code
Checks the code, creates a DB session, returns access + refresh tokens
Tokens saved to SecureStore; on 401/403 baseApi refreshes once

flows.title: Admin uploads a song (transcode → index → publish)
flows.summary: Browser uploads to the temp bucket; adminBackend creates a Job and fires Inngest; audioProcessing transcodes and calls back webhooks; finalize creates the song.

steps.text: Admin UI gets a presigned URL and PUTs the file into the temp bucket
Creates a Job row (QUEUED) and a new song id
Hands off to Inngest
Sends audio/fetchjob (event id job-{id}-{attempt})
Reads the job from GET /webhook/job/{id}, sends audio/song.transcode
Runs audio, video, canvas and feature extraction in parallel
FFmpeg 128/240/320k AAC + Shaka packager → S3 audios/{songId}/
Recommendation index
Search index
POST /webhook/job/{id}/finalize
Deletes temp files, creates the Song (ACTIVE), job COMPLETED, outbox catalog.song.v1
Emails followers of the artist about the new release

flows.title: Delete a song (cleanup chain)
flows.summary: Each step is its own Inngest function, so a failure retries only that step.

steps.text: Creates a delete job, sends audio/delete.algolia
Removes from search → sends .recombee
Removes from recommendations → sends .imagekit
Removes canvas clips → sends .s3
Deletes audios/ and videos/ prefixes → sends .finalize
Hard-deletes the rows through the admin webhook

flows.title: Post a short (listener)
flows.summary: Presigned upload, then Inngest transcodes to 9:16 HLS and the admin webhook marks it READY.

steps.text: Checks the ban and the 5-a-day limit (Redis), returns a presigned PUT
App uploads the raw video to shorts-raw/{uuid}
Creates the short (PROCESSING) and sends shorts/process
Validates (≤60 s, ≤100 MB), transcodes 720/540/360p, thumbnail
Sets READY (or HIDDEN); if deleted meanwhile, sends shorts/delete

flows.title: Outbox: database change → Kafka, exactly once
flows.summary: State changes write an outbox row in the same transaction; the relay publishes it.

steps.text: Writes the favourite and publishes a Spring event
BEFORE_COMMIT: same transaction
INSERT INTO outbox_events
After commit: nudges the relay via outbox.wakeup.v1
Locks rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Publishes each row as Avro to its topic; DLQ after max attempts

flows.title: Admin song analytics page
flows.summary: KPIs and the heatmap come from small Postgres aggregates; audience numbers come from DuckDB over the S3 lake (cached 10 min in Redis).

steps.text: Admin opens /songs/{id}
React Query: GET /admin/song/{id}/analytics?range=
Aggregates from song_timeline / song_listen_daily / song_quality_daily
Unique and returning listeners from the lake
Chunk test runs in the admin's browser against S3

failures.what: Any BaseException (BadRequest, NotFound, Conflict, Forbidden, TooManyRequests, Unauthorized, ExternalService)
failures.result: JSON ErrorResponseDto with the exception's HTTP status
500 with a generic message; logged by CentralizedLoggingAspect
Logs and reads Postgres directly
DUAL: ignored, legacy path still runs. KAFKA: 503 EventsUnavailable, the app keeps the events and retries
Retries with backoff, then logs; the user request is not failed (async after commit)
Events stay in AsyncStorage (max 500) and are retried every 10 s
Falls back to the per-event endpoints for 10 minutes
One shared refresh (POST /auth/refresh-token); logs out only if the refresh itself is rejected
Retries network errors with backoff, recoverMediaError for media errors, then a toast
3 retries 2 s apart, then the record goes to pipeline.dlq.v1
Dropped (24 h event_id window); sinks write absolute totals so replays don't double-count
Retry topic notification.email.retry.v1, then DLQ
Attempt counter; after the max, the row goes to pipeline.dlq.v1. A 6 h safety sweep catches missed wake-ups
Then onFailure posts /webhook/job/{id}/failed (job FAILED, visible in the Jobs page with Retry)
Fails immediately, no retries
Re-runs FFmpeg with software encoding
Inngest stops the running function; temp files are cleaned up
Admin sessions fall back to in-memory

failures.what: Inngest send fails on song create
failures.result: Known gap: the view still returns 201 and the job stays PENDING until retried from the Jobs page
mail_queue_delayed (5 s doubling, max 30 s), after 3 tries mail_queue_dlq; auth errors pause 30 s

coreEngine.title: Core API (Spring Boot)
coreEngine.role: Everything the listener apps call: catalog, search, playback data, library, auth, shorts, telemetry intake.
coreEngine.run: Docker/core on EC2 behind Caddy · port 9090
coreEngine.layers: Controllers/* → Services/* → Repository/* (Spring Data JPA) · Shorts/ uses JdbcClient · Cache/ Redis · Events/Kafka producer + outbox

streams.title: Event pipeline (Kafka Streams)
streams.role: Turns events into aggregates and side effects: stats, sessions, history, analytics, outbox relay, emails, Recombee/Algolia sync.
streams.switches: STREAMS_PROFILES (outbox-relay, stats, activity, sync, notification, analytics)
streams.layers: *Topology (Kafka Streams DSL, exactly-once) → topics → *Sink (@KafkaListener batch → JdbcTemplate upserts)

communication.title: Event contracts
communication.role: Avro schemas and topic names shared by producer and consumers; snapshot test enforces BACKWARD compatibility.

migration.title: Database migrations (Flyway)
migration.role: Owns the Postgres schema (V1–V19). Run before deploying.

adminBackend.title: Admin API (Django REST)
adminBackend.role: Catalog management, jobs, shorts moderation, analytics, webhooks for the media pipeline.
adminBackend.layers: */urls.py → *views.py (APIView) → core/services/* → unmanaged models over Flyway tables

audioProcessing.title: Media pipeline (Bun + Inngest)
audioProcessing.role: Transcodes songs, videos, canvas clips and shorts; indexes search and recommendations; deletes media.
audioProcessing.layers: functions/* (Inngest functions, one step each) → lib/transcode, lib/* → axios webhooks to adminBackend

mailEvents.title: Mail worker (Bun)
mailEvents.role: Legacy email path: pops the Redis mail_queue and sends.

util.title: Sync scripts
util.role: One-off backfills of Algolia and Recombee straight from Postgres.

audioApp.title: Mobile app (Expo / React Native)
audioApp.role: The listener app: home, search, shorts, library, player.
audioApp.layers: src/app (Expo Router screens) → components → store (Redux) / service/* (axios) → service/player (expo-audio pool, ListenTracker, telemetry queue)

audioFrontend.title: Web player (Next.js)
audioFrontend.layers: src/app (pages) → *ClientView → components → store/player (Redux + TanStack Store) → lib/api/* (axios, cookies)

adminFrontend.title: Admin dashboard (Next.js)
adminFrontend.role: Catalog, jobs, shorts, users, analytics and the chunk inspector.
adminFrontend.layers: src/app (pages) → components → lib/queries/* (React Query) → lib/adminFetch → adminBackend
